description:
Makes the DVB-T2 FEC decode stage of `gf2-sim` decode through the generic batch decode stage with the DVB-T2 concatenated batch decoder.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. A `gf2-sim` stage processes a batch by shared reference with a default-constructed mutable scratch. The generic batch decode stage of `gf2-sim` holds a factory of a `gf2-coding` batch soft decoder, builds the decoder once in its scratch, and decodes an `LlrBatch` into a `HardDecisionBatch` with the per-frame iteration counts recorded in the scratch. `gf2-coding` has a DVB-T2 concatenated implementer of the trait [Etsi2015]. The stage `DvbT2Decode` calls `DvbT2Concat::decode_soft_counted` once per frame, which serializes frames through one mutex-guarded LDPC decoder, and records the per-frame iteration counts in its scratch.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `DvbT2Decode` decodes its batch through the generic batch decode stage with the DVB-T2 concatenated batch decoder, and holds no per-frame loop.
- [hard] REQ-02: The BBFRAME of each frame and the recorded per-frame iteration counts equal those of the per-frame `decode_soft_counted` path, including for a frame whose LDPC decode does not converge.
- [hard] REQ-03: The DVB-T2 regression, stage round-trip and preset-versus-graph byte-identity suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

Source references: [Etsi2015].
title: Decode DVB-T2 stage batches through the batch decode stage
